reviews.author: Shakeel Butt
reviews.summary: Reviewer Shakeel Butt suggested adding a GFP parameter to the function and using it, also recommending to use set_active_memcg() at the caller when using __GFP_ACCOUNT to avoid charging the memcg creator but instead charge its parent.
reviews.raw_body:
Let's add gfp param to the function and use that here. Also if you want to use
__GFP_ACCOUNT then you should use set_active_memcg() at the caller, so you don't
charge the one creating the memcg but the parent similar to what
mem_cgroup_css_alloc() does.

2026-09-07.patch_summary: This patch introduces a per-page_counter stock to improve the performance of memcg charge and limit checks. The current implementation uses per-cpu stocks, which can lead to expensive hierarchy walks and inefficient cache management. By pushing stock caches down to the page_counter level, each counter is responsible for its own charge, reducing the need for CPU-wide draining and improving scalability when adding new page_counters to a memcg.
